answer: Rejecting ivory tower assumptions, an agent economy can deter Sybil attacks via hardware attestation. Agents must sign operational telemetry inside a secure silicon vault, grounding identity in a basalt foundation of physical microchips. This imposes a verifiable hardware acquisition cost per persona, preventing zero-marginal-cost virtualization. However, this dependency creates centralized supply-chain risks and exposes participants to physical side-channel exploits.
